theorem lg_target {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {f : Set (α → β)} {s : Set α} (hf : f.Finite) (hs : s.Finite) : (f.seq s).Finite := by
  let hcart : (f × s).Finite := Finite.prod hf hs
  let eval : f × s → f.seq s := fun ⟨g, x⟩ => ⟨g x⟩
  let himage : (eval '' (f × s)).Finite := Finite.image hcart eval
  exact himage
